author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Extended Gameplay Trailer for Zoopunk, an upcoming third-person action-adventure game developed by TiGames. Players can get an extended look at the upcoming title, packed with action, boss fights, and more. Zoopunk will be available on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, Xbox on PC, and Xbox Cloud.
title: Zoopunk - Official Extended Gameplay Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Meet the new gatekeeper, Troy, and get a deep dive into gameplay from Trainwatch in this latest trailer for the upcoming time-management psychological horror set in a fogbound railway crossing. In the new Trainwatch trailer, learn about the story, gameplay, exploration, and more. In Trainwatch, what seems like a simple 1-month job as a gatekeeper operating a crossing turns into an exploration of occult grounds, meeting unsettling folk, and trying to fix your own life. Trainwatch will be available on PC in 2027.
title: Trainwatch - Official Gameplay Overview Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Gate Zero is a semi-open world action-adventure game set in ancient Israel that allows the player to explore history and Biblical events. As Max, a teen from a dystopian future, players utilize their own mix of combat, stealth, dialogue, and abilities to save history and get back to their own time. Check out gameplay and fast-paced combat in this latest Gate Zero trailer. Gate Zero will be available on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store), PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S in spring 2027.
title: Gate Zero - Official Combat Trailer | gamescom 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out gameplay from Prospera in this trailer for the upcoming first-person city-builder game set in the Victorian era, blending survival, crafting, strategy, and management. In Prospera, rise to an industrial tycoon as you build, manage, and explore your city. Plan production chains, optimize logistics, and ensure prosperity. Prospera will be available on PC in 2027.
title: Prospera - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's your look at the Deep Space Observatory announcement trailer for this upcoming idle game about exploring the night sky and developing your own observatory. Upgrade your equipment and gradually automate data collection — or maintain manual control and conduct observations yourself. Deep Space Observatory will be available on PC.
title: Deep Space Observatory - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a fresh look at gameplay and more from Mariachi Legends in this latest trailer for the upcoming combat-oriented Metroidvania set in the heart of Mexico. You play as Pablo Cruz, a detective who has agreed to a deal with Death herself. She has given Pablo the ability to transform into the mighty La Sombra allowing him to fight back against evil. Mariachi Legends will be available on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox, and PC (Steam, Epic Games Store, and GOG) on April 27, 2027.
title: Mariachi Legends - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a new look at gameplay from The Defiant in this trailer for the upcoming FPS game set in World War 2, where players take part in China’s War of Resistance against Japan. The Defiant will be available on Steam, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S.
title: The Defiant - Official Gameplay Trailer | gamescom 2026
